T: Jamaica first. The doctor can wait.
D: James Bond flies to Jamaica to find out why a British agent has vanished.
P: Serve the snacks when Bond meets Quarrel and Felix at Puss-Feller's bar on the Kingston waterfront.
S: Kingston stamp and go saltfish fritters
street food off the Kingston waterfront

Soak 250g salt cod overnight in cold water, changing it twice, then simmer for 15 minutes, drain and flake. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 180ml water into a thick batter and stir in the fish, 3 sliced spring onions, a chopped red chilli, a tsp of thyme, a crushed garlic clove, a diced tomato and pepper. Fry spoonfuls in oil at 180C for 3 minutes until golden, drain and serve with lime wedges.
packed for Quarrel's boat on the run to Crab Key

Peel 3 green plantains and slice them 2mm thick on a mandoline. Fry in batches in oil at 175C for 3 minutes until crisp and pale gold, drain, then toss with sea salt, a little chilli powder and the zest and juice of a lime.
3 green plantains or green cooking bananas@Produce
M: Quarrel's jerk chicken with rice and peas
Cayman Islander cooking, the way Quarrel would do it on the boat

Blitz 4 spring onions, a scotch bonnet, 4 garlic cloves, ginger, 3 tsp allspice, 2 tsp thyme, cinnamon, nutmeg, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 tbsp soy, a lime's juice, oil, pepper and salt to a paste and rub into 1.2kg slashed chicken thighs. Marinate at least 4 hours. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, then char on a hot barbecue or under the grill. Simmer 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water with spring onion, garlic, allspice and thyme, add 300g rice and a tin of kidney beans and cook covered for 18 minutes. Serve with lime wedges.
1.2kg chicken thighs, bone in, skin on@Meat
W: Jamaican coconut cake, sweet as the beach she walks out onto

Mix 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp cinnamon, half a tsp nutmeg, salt, 150g brown sugar and 100g desiccated coconut. Whisk in an egg, 250ml coconut milk, 80g melted butter and vanilla, spread in a greased 20cm square tin and scatter with demerara and shredded coconut. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes, cool and serve in squares with cream whipped with lime zest.
80g butter, melted, plus extra for the tin@Dairy
K: one sour, two sweet, three strong, four weak, poured at the waterfront bar
Stir 60ml lime juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 180ml dark rum, 240ml pineapple juice and 4 dashes of bitters in a jug and chill for 30 minutes. Pour over ice, grate over nutmeg and add a lime wheel.

dishes.n: Kingston stamp and go saltfish fritters
dishes.make_ahead: Soak the salt cod overnight, changing the water twice, and flake it up to 1 day ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Soak the salt cod in cold water in the fridge overnight, changing the water twice.
Simmer the cod in fresh water for 15 minutes, drain, then flake it, picking out any skin and bones.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and water into a thick batter.
Stir in the cod, spring onions, chilli, thyme, garlic, tomato and pepper.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep heavy pan.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in batches for 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain on paper towel.
Serve hot with the lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the corn and spinach up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; make the batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the corn dry and chop the spinach.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and water into a thick batter.
Stir in the corn, spinach, spring onions, chilli, thyme, garlic, tomato and pepper.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep heavy pan.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in batches for 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain on paper towel.
Serve hot with the lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Fry up to 1 day ahead and keep airtight; season again just before serving

ingredients.item: green plantains or green cooking bananas

steps.text: Cut the ends off the plantains, score the skin along the ridges and prise it off.
Slice the plantains 2mm thick on a mandoline.
Heat the oil to 175C in a deep heavy pan.
Fry in batches for about 3 minutes until crisp and pale gold, then drain on paper towel.
Toss with the salt, chilli powder and the zest and a squeeze of the lime.

dishes.n: Quarrel's jerk chicken with rice and peas
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken at least 4 hours or overnight in the fridge; cook the rice and peas on the night

ingredients.item: chicken thighs, bone in, skin on

steps.text: Blitz 4 of the spring onions, the chilli, 4 garlic cloves, the ginger, 3 tsp of the allspice, 2 tsp of the thyme, the cinnamon, nutmeg, sugar, soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, oil, pepper and 1 tsp of the salt to a paste.
Slash the chicken to the bone, rub all over with the marinade and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the chicken on a rack for 40 minutes, then char on a hot barbecue or under the grill for 5 minutes.

For the rice and peas, bring the coconut milk, water, the last 2 spring onions bashed whole, the last garlic clove crushed, the remaining allspice, thyme and salt to a simmer. Add the rice and beans, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then stand for 5.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes and serve with the rice and peas and the second lime in wedges.

veg.n: Quarrel's jerk cauliflower with rice and peas
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the cauliflower and haloumi up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the rice and peas on the night

steps.text: Blitz 4 of the spring onions, the chilli, 4 garlic cloves, the ginger, 3 tsp of the allspice, 2 tsp of the thyme, the cinnamon, nutmeg, sugar, soy sauce, juice of 1 lime, oil, pepper and 1 tsp of the salt to a paste.
Rub the cauliflower wedges and haloumi all over with the marinade and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the cauliflower on a lined tray for 35 minutes until tender and charred at the edges, then sear the haloumi in a hot pan for 2 minutes a side.

For the rice and peas, bring the coconut milk, water, the last 2 spring onions bashed whole, the last garlic clove crushed, the remaining allspice, thyme and salt to a simmer. Add the rice and beans, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes, then stand for 5.
Serve the cauliflower and haloumi with the rice and peas and the second lime in wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight; whip the cream just before serving

ingredients.item: butter, melted, plus extra for the tin

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C and butter a 20cm square tin.
Mix the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, brown sugar and desiccated coconut.
Whisk the egg, coconut milk, melted butter and vanilla and stir into the dry mix.
Spread into the tin and scatter with the demerara and shredded coconut.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 20 minutes.
Whip the cream with the lime zest to soft peaks and serve with the toto cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix and chill the punch in a jug up to 4 hours ahead; pour over ice and grate the nutmeg to order

steps.text: Stir the lime juice, sugar syrup, rum, pineapple juice and bitters together in a jug.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Pour over ice in 4 glasses, grate over a little nutmeg and add a lime wheel.

af.make_ahead: Brew the tea and mix the punch up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; pour over ice and grate the nutmeg to order

steps.text: Brew the tea strong, stir in the molasses and cool.
Stir the lime juice, sugar syrup, tea, pineapple juice and allspice together in a jug.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Pour over ice in 4 glasses, grate over a little nutmeg and add a lime wheel.
